name: Ivar the Foul
summary: At the Ivar Patch in northern Silverpine, Ivar the Foul has trapped two Deathstalkers. Rane asks Horde travelers to kill the savage ghoul so Quinn can recover and they can finish their report to High Executor Hadrec.

sections.title: A Mission Derailed
sections.body: Rane and Quinn Yorick, siblings and Deathstalkers, were sent to survey Silverpine Forest for High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher. Their work ended in violence at a farmstead in the northern forest, where Ivar the Foul ambushed them.

sections.title: The Threat in the Barn
sections.body: Rane and Quinn escaped, but Quinn was badly mauled. An alchemical remedy made from forest beasts has not made him strong enough to travel. Ivar prowls the nearby barn, waiting for Rane's guard to fail. She asks Horde travelers to enter the barn and kill him, so the homestead can be secured.

faq.answer: Ivar the Foul is a Scourge ghoul lurking in northern Silverpine Forest. The Ivar Patch was once his farm, and he and most of his family and workers fell to the Scourge. He now ambushes passersby and attacks Forsaken scouts there.

faq.q: Where can Ivar the Foul be found?
faq.answer: Ivar lurks in the barn at the Ivar Patch, just north of the ruined farmhouse where Rane and Quinn Yorick have taken shelter.

faq.q: Who are Rane and Quinn Yorick?
faq.answer: Rane and Quinn Yorick are Forsaken siblings, a sister and brother, and Deathstalkers. High Executor Hadrec sent them to survey enemy activity in Silverpine Forest, where Ivar ambushed them.

faq.q: Why does Rane ask an adventurer to kill Ivar?
faq.answer: Quinn was badly mauled in their first encounter and is still recovering. Rane must guard her brother against sudden Scourge attacks, so she cannot hunt Ivar herself.

faq.q: Who receives the report on Ivar's death?
faq.answer: High Executor Hadrec, the military commander at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, receives the scouts' reconnaissance logs. Rane promises to commend the adventurer's help in them.

faq.q: What happens after Ivar is slain?
faq.answer: Killing Ivar the Foul ends the siblings' ordeal at the Ivar Patch. With the immediate danger gone, Quinn has time to heal before they finish their survey of the forest.

angles.text: As an Undead, you know the danger faced by the Deathstalkers. Forsaken scouts caught behind enemy lines must rely on champions who come their way.
As a member of the Horde, you help protect Forsaken supply lines and strategic ground in Lordaeron by clearing away Scourge remnants like Ivar.
As a Rogue, you know the danger of stealth reconnaissance when ravenous Scourge horrors catch you unaware.
